dataset_name: SynaptiPy eNeuro Scientific Methods validation cohort

selection.protocol_filter: Long Square sweeps; active sweeps require positive current steps and passive sweeps require hyperpolarizing steps
selection.purpose: Benchmark SynaptiPy active and passive intracellular feature extraction against eFEL and IPFX.
notes: Cells are intentionally fixed for paper reproducibility.
Generated NWB files are cached locally and are not committed to git.
Regenerate with paper/scripts/generate_paper_tables.py --force when the SynaptiPy algorithms intentionally change.
